title: Canonical Letter to Domnus
edition: PG 77; CPG 5378? Epistula canonica ad Domnum
scope: Canon 1 and the opening of canon 2
blurb: A fresh English translation of Cyril of Alexandria’s canonical letter to Domnus about Peter, a bishop removed from his church without a hearing. Cyril asks that Peter be heard in a proper trial if he wishes, and that the money taken from him be returned.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation of Cyril of Alexandria’s Epistula canonica ad Domnum, made from the Greek of PG 77 (Khazarzar transcription). No modern English version was used as wording, and there is no ANF or NPNF English of this work.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation from the Greek of PG 77.
